Details data.title: upay NPSB: Easy, Convenient & Cost-Effective Money Transfer
Details data.title bn: upay NPSB: Easy, Convenient & Cost-Effective Money Transfer
Details data.desc:
From : 23 August, 2026 Till Announcement

Feature Details:
Customers will be able to Fund Transfer and Add Money via NPSB channel.
NPSB -Add Money will be credited into upay customer’s Secondary wallet. Salary wallet is renamed as Secondary wallet.
The feature aims to provide a seamless, convenient and cost-effective Fund transfer experience while increasing NPSB interoperability usage among upay customers.
Customers need to update app for this feature.

Workflow:
upay Homepage → NPSB → Select MFS/Bank/PSP

MFS:
Select MFS Operator → Enter Wallet Number and Wallet Holder Name → Click Save as Beneficiary (Optional) → Proceed → Enter Amount → Enter PIN → Slide to Confirm

Bank:
Select Bank Name → Enter Account Number and Account Name → Click Save as Beneficiary (Optional) → Proceed → Enter Amount → Enter PIN → Slide to Confirm

NPSB Charge: 

Types Charges
Fund Transfer   0.85%
Add Money 0

Cashout Campaign for NPSB from Secondary Wallet:

Channel Cash Out Charge per 1000
Agent 0.80%
UCB ATM 0

Terms & Conditions:
